text:
maria-l: Can we pause the eu-west-1 canary? After chart upgrade to v2.5.0 we're seeing a sustained ~2% 500s on stg-edgezone.

deploy-bot: Canary started for release v2.5.0 -> target: web-service (3/30 nodes) in eu-west-1

aj: Rollout noticed db connection pool change in the new values:```yaml
db:
  poolSize: 30
  timeout: 30s
```we previously ran 60. That could explain saturation under heavy traffic.

leo: Oof, that pool change should have been behind a flag. Suggest pin chart to v2.4.1 in eu-west-1 and continue rollout elsewhere.

sophie: If we pin regionally, we need release notes + a rollback note. I'll assemble notes if we decide. Who can approve a regional pin?

maria-l: @oncall-bot can you hold the canary and add a manual hold until we decide? Also add a quick note to the release that db.poolSize changed.

oncall-bot: Manual hold placed on canary in eu-west-1 by maria-l. Reason: increased 500s after values change. Hold expires: 1h unless released manually.

deploy-bot: Preflight check failed on eu-west-1 post-upgrade: `PostInstallHookTimeout`. Helm diff snippet:```
+ spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[3] changed
+ config.db.poolSize: 60 -> 30
```

aj: Reproduced locally in k8s-staging: under sustained load kv-store threads starve when poolSize=30. Quick mitigation: set `values.db.poolSize=60` and run: `helm upgrade --set db.poolSize=60 --reuse-values --namespace prod web-service ./chart --version 2.5.0 --atomic`

leo: That's fine as a stopgap, but patching the canary might mask other behavioral diffs in 2.5.0. Prefer pinning the canary back to 2.4.1 and cut 2.5.1 with the poolSize change behind a feature flag.

sophie: I'll draft the release note: changed values, migration action (increase pool), and note about regional pin. Anyone object to pin+patch plan?

maria-l: No objections. Action items: 1) @aj pin canary in eu-west-1 to v2.4.1 (helm rollback / pin), 2) @devops schedule 2.5.1 with db flag, 3) @sophie update release notes and notify customers affected.

aj: On it. Doing `helm rollback web-service 12 --namespace prod --kube-context=eu-west-1` now, then pin chart image digest in release control-plane.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by aj: rollback to v2.4.1 (release 12) in eu-west-1. Health checks OK: 3/3 Ready.

sophie: Drafted notes & added migration step. Attached to ticket #INF-3245 and pinged product for customer-facing blurb.

maria-l: Thanks. We'll reopen canary after 2.5.1 with the db flag enabled and gradual ramp. :white_check_mark:

leo: Follow-up: add checklist item to PR template for any values that change infra thresholds (db pools, concurrency, timeouts).

sophie: Noted. I'll add that to the release checklist and PR template. :memo:

(many reactions :thumbsup: in-channel)
